description: Calculates indicators from prices the user gives. Use it when the user gives their own prices and wants indicators calculated, such as "calculate ATR and stochastic from these candles". Best for any asset the user has prices for: stocks, crypto, commodities or a spreadsheet column, and for atr, stochastic and vwap. Input tips: pass prices (2 to 250 candles, oldest first, each with a numeric close and optionally time, open, high, low and volume) and indicators from sma, ema, rsi, macd, bollinger, atr, stochastic and vwap; optionally periods and series_length. atr and stochastic need high and low on every candle, and vwap needs high, low and volume. Returns the latest value and a short series for each indicator, with the settings used. Makes no outside request and keeps nothing. Not for: fetching prices, forecasts, or buy or sell advice. Informational only, not financial advice; gives no signals.

indicators.description: Indicators to calculate, such as ["rsi", "macd"]: sma, ema, rsi, macd (12, 26, 9), bollinger (2 standard deviations), atr, stochastic (%K and %D) and vwap (cumulative over the given candles)

periods.description: Lookback length per indicator, in candles, such as {"sma": 50}. Any left out use the default shown. Whole numbers from 2 to 100.

prices.description: Candles, oldest first, 2 to 250, such as [{"time": "2026-09-01", "high": 10.6, "low": 9.7, "close": 10.2}]. Prices are plain numbers in any one unit.

close.description: Closing price of the candle, such as 101.2. Used by every indicator.

high.description: Highest price of the candle, such as 102.3. Needed on every candle for atr, stochastic and vwap; not below low.

low.description: Lowest price of the candle, such as 99.8. Needed on every candle for atr, stochastic and vwap.

open.description: Opening price of the candle, such as 101.5. Optional; no indicator reads it.

time.description: Date or time of the candle, such as "2026-09-30"; only echoed back

volume.description: Traded volume of the candle, such as 15400, 0 or more. Needed on every candle for vwap.

series_length.description: How many of the most recent values to return for each indicator, such as 10. 5 by default.

name: compute_indicators

asOf.description: Date or time of the last price used, or the date of the call when no price was read

candles.description: Number of candles the indicators were calculated over. 0 when the call was refused before any price was read.

code.description: Stable code, such as invalid_symbol, invalid_prices, invalid_periods or nothing_to_calculate

hint.description: The next step: what to change in the call or tell the user

indicators.description: One entry per calculated indicator, in the order asked. Empty when status is not ok.
